title: Chain-of-Memory: Lightweight Memory Construction with Dynamic Evolution for LLM Agents
authors: Xiucheng Xu; Bingbing Xu; Xueyun Tian; Zihe Huang; Rongxin Chen; Yunfan Li; Huawei Shen
why_relevant: Proposes a memory framework for LLM agents with adaptive truncation to prune noise in retrieved memory fragments, tangentially touching noisy retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on agent memory construction/utilization efficiency, not on robustness of RAG to unreliable evidence, conflicts, or adversaries.
